title: The Convergence of All Owed Things

features.name: ledger hall
features.desc-on-touch: A warehouse where all debts converge into one debt. You can read the names of who owes whom, but the words are written in obligations instead of letters.

features.name: settlement shed
features.desc-on-touch: A small building where things are made right. Inside, obligations are balanced like goods on scales. Nothing ever quite tips evenly.

features.name: debt-tree with copper bark
features.desc-on-touch: A tree grown from ore that learned it was owed something. The bark conducts the weight of unpaid promises. Still growing.

features.name: intersection of paths
features.desc-on-touch: Where all the roads that carried debts meet and end. You can see the footprints of everyone who came to settle what they owed.

features.name: balance stone
features.desc-on-touch: A weight worn smooth by constant use. It measures what is owed and what has been paid. It is always still not balanced.

inscription: here all the things we owed learned to become one thing; here all debts converge

file.name: Registry_Of_Convergent_Obligations_All_Paths_All_Debts_One_Settlement.txt
file.note: A ledger where every obligation is listed twice—once as owed, once as owing. The two columns try to meet but never quite align.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the red earth where settling becomes one thing
narr: You sat with her on the rust-coloured ground at dusk, and she
said: we've all owed something. You watched the shadows lengthen.
She meant the archive, the mesh, the network of promises that held
it all together. She meant herself. She meant you. Later you would
understand: she was saying goodbye by saying what was owed had
finally come due. That night, all debts converged into one.

exits.label: upward to the living stone that remembers minerals
eastward to where debts learn to breed
westward into the dark where settlement never ends
